'''Gojō Tenjin Shrine''' (五條天神社 or 五条天神社) refers to Shinto shrines. As religious corporations, there are two entities: one registered as "五條天神社" and another as "五条天神社."

* [[Gojō Tenjin Shrine (Taitō-ku)]] - Located in [[Ueno Park]], [[Taitō|Taitō, Tokyo]], [[Tokyo]].
* [[Gojō Tenjin-gū]] - Located in [[Shimogyō-ku, Kyoto|Shimogyō-ku]], [[Kyoto]], [[Kyoto Prefecture]]. Its registered name as a religious corporation uses the modern form, "五条天神社."

== Related Articles ==
* [[Gojō Castle Tenjin Shrine]] - Located in Uchiko-chō, Kita District, Ehime Prefecture.
* [[Gojōzan Tenjin Shrine]] - Located in Akabanechō, Nara City, Nara Prefecture.
* [[Goryō Tenjin Shrine]] - Located in Hanada-chō, Himeji City, Hyōgo Prefecture. The registered name as a religious corporation uses the traditional kanji, "五靈天神社."
* [[Tenjinsha|Tenjin Shrine (disambiguation)]]
